from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545726/attempts/1215c664ab1d474cb6ca911ca8ae1318/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full-width/height uniform lines define the repeated panels.
    hrules = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    vrules = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    # Keep only lines whose color is distinct from the surrounding panel background.
    bg = max({v for row in grid for v in row}, key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
    hrules = [r for r in hrules if grid[r][0] != bg]
    vrules = [c for c in vrules if grid[0][c] != bg]
    rbounds = [-1] + hrules + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + vrules + [w]
    panels = []
    for ri in range(len(rbounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = rbounds[ri]+1, rbounds[ri+1]
        if r0 >= r1: continue
        for ci in range(len(cbounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = cbounds[ci]+1, cbounds[ci+1]
            if c0 >= c1: continue
            panels.append((r0, r1, c0, c1))
    patterns = []
    for r0, r1, c0, c1 in panels:
        cells = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1)] for r in range(r0,r1)]
        if any(v != bg for row in cells for v in row):
            patterns.append(cells)
    # The sole populated panel supplies the pattern for every panel.
    pattern = patterns[0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1, c0, c1 in panels:
        for dr in range(r1-r0):
            for dc in range(c1-c0):
                out[r0+dr][c0+dc] = pattern[dr][dc]
    return out
'''
path=program_dir/'task-56d16495.py'
path.write_text(source)
print(path)
